'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**Ten [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|Yemeni soldiers]] from a southern [[Separatism|separatist]] faction are killed and twelve others are injured in an attack by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] [[militant]]s at the border between [[Al Bayda Governorate|Al Bayda]] and [[Lahij Governorate|Lahij]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Idalia|Tropical Storm Idalia]] forms in the [[Gulf of Mexico]] as the tenth [[tropical storm]] or [[subtropical storm]] of the [[2023 Atlantic hurricane season]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/article/tropical-storm-idalia-hurricane.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2023 Tver Oblast plane crash]]
**[[Government of Russia|Russia]]'s [[Investigative Committee of Russia|Investigative Committee]] confirms the identities of the bodies recovered at crash site corresponds to the names on the flight list.  [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/08/27/wagner-boss-prigozhins-death-confirmed-by-russian-investigators-moscow-a82260 (AFP via ''The Moscow Times'')]
*At least 13 people are killed in [[Vahdat]] and [[Rudaki District|Rudaki]], [[Tajikistan]], due to heavy rains that triggered [[landslide]]s and falling rocks. [https://ptvnews.ph/heavy-rains-leave-13-dead-in-tajikistan/ (AFP via PTV News)]
*Three [[United States Marine Corps|US Marines]] are killed and 20 others are injured when their [[Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey|MV-22B Osprey]] [[tiltrotor]] crashes on [[Melville Island (Northern Territory)|Melville Island]], [[Northern Territory]], [[Australia]]. '''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea]]
***The [[North Korean government]] announces the lifting of certain [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic-era travel restrictions]], allowing [[Korean diaspora|citizens abroad]] to return to [[North Korea|the country]] provided that they [[quarantine]] for one week. [https://www.wionews.com/world/north-korea-relaxes-covid-isolation-permits-citizens-abroad-to-return-629650 (AFP via WION)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Libya relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Libya|Libyan Prime Minister]] [[Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh]] suspends [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Libya)|Foreign Minister]] [[Najla El Mangoush]] for administrative investigation following reports of an unauthorized meeting with [[Israeli Foreign Minister]] [[Eli Cohen (politician, born 1972)|Eli Cohen]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230827-libyan-foreign-minister-suspended-over-talks-with-israeli-counterpart (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Police of Poland|Police]] arrest two male [[Polish nationality law|Polish citizens]] suspected of [[Cybercrime|hacking]] into the [[Polish State Railways|national railway]] [[Communications-based train control|communication system]], disrupting [[Rail transport in Poland|rail traffic]] in [[Poland]] and issuing false [[Railway signal|signal]]s. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/08/28/Two-men-detained-in-connection-with-Polish-railway-hacking- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 PGA Tour]]
**[[2023 FedEx Cup Playoffs]]
***In [[golf]], [[Norway]]'s [[Viktor Hovland]] wins the [[PGA Tour|U.S. PGA Tour]]'s season-ending [[Tour Championship]] and secures the [[FedEx Cup]] championship trophy, finishing five [[Stroke play|strokes]] ahead of the [[Golf in the United States|United States]]' [[Xander Schauffele]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230827-hovland-outduels-schauffele-to-win-pga-tour-championship (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2023 U.S. National Gymnastics Championships]]
**In [[artistic gymnastics]], [[Simone Biles]] sets a new record for the most [[Gymnastics all-around champions by age|all-around titles]] by a gymnast of either gender, surpassing the previous record set by [[Al Jochim]] in 1933, after winning her eighth title at the individual all-around event of this year's [[USA Gymnastics National Championships]]. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/8/28/dazzling-biles-wins-record-eighth-us-all-around-gymnastics-title (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]
